name: A burglary in progress
description: You see somebody breaking into a neighbouring home.
initiallyKnown: You are Alex Morgan. You are safely inside your own locked home.
32 Rehearsal Road, London, SE1 0ZZ (invented training address).
From your window you can see one person forcing a rear window of the neighbouring house. It is happening now.
The person has a dark jacket and a red backpack. You have not seen a weapon. You do not know whether anybody is inside.

criteria.label: Exact location
criteria.rule: Building number/name and street plus town, or an unambiguous named place with precise access point. A town alone is partial. Ask for a postcode if known, but do not force a guess.

criteria.label: What has happened
criteria.rule: A sufficiently clear description of the incident.

criteria.label: Fictional callback number
criteria.rule: A usable callback number supplied by the caller. Confirm unclear digits.

criteria.label: Caller location and safety
criteria.rule: Caller describes where they are and whether in immediate danger.

criteria.label: What can be seen
criteria.rule: Caller describes what they observed, including number/description if known; accepts explicit uncertainty.

criteria.label: Known immediate risks
criteria.rule: Caller reports whether any weapon or immediate threat was observed; unknown is acceptable.

completion.required: Selected service matches scenario and required details communicated; closing statement heard.

responderProtocol.behaviour: Collect information only; no medical, rescue, crime-scene or firefighting instructions; never claim dispatch.

assessment.review: AI observations require clinician review; do not infer impairment from pace, accent or transcription.
